changes: Created the canonical Dynamic Finding execution plan: seven historical Finding problems with reproducible evidence, four responsibility components, defer-with-proof safeguards, three implementation Stories, rollout metrics, gate contracts, and package-name boundaries.
usage: Use docs/requirements/decisions/dynamic-finding-system-execution-plan.md as the design and acceptance contract; implement the follow-up dependency order Finding Ledger and Runtime Evidence Integrity, then Finding Identity and Historical Lineage, then Dynamic Finding Applicability.
expectedOutcome: A reader can trace the seven historical problems to evidence and understand exactly how the four components and three Stories reduce irrelevant Finding work without weakening high/critical, evidence, freshness, routing, or lifecycle gates.
actualTranscript: Independent concept, quality, test-coverage, docs, and delivery reviews passed with zero findings; the target document blob remained stable; rename guard passed; routine validation passed 120/120; DONE-required build and root npm test passed 58/58 with zero retries.
outcomeDiff: No material difference: the delivered document and recorded verification match the expected user-visible outcome.
limitations: This Story delivers the audited specification only. It does not implement Dynamic Finding runtime schemas or gates, create the three follow-up Stories, or rename @lattice/lab; those remain explicitly allocated future work.
pitfalls: The shared document Story gate ran repository-wide validation because applicability filtering is not implemented. One attempt hit the flat 900-second timeout, reviewer receipts required re-signing after trust drift, and a changed validation identity forced a TEST-stage rerun; shared capacity also caused queue waits. Preserve the successful current evidence and avoid retries at an unchanged TEST anchor.
